name: Maid
source:
A maid who works at the Garrideb household. Her main duty appears to be standing at Mr Garrideb's side pouring tea.
[spoiler]In truth, Mr Garrideb's wife, who poses as the household maid merely to keep up appearances in the neighborhood. She has a fierce temper and tends to get rather physical. She is in attendance as a member of the jury for the first trial of Soseki Natsume.[/spoiler]

[Edited from in-game profiles]
